agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Grouped provider-free verification must select only exact paths discovered from the repository test inventory.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first grouped command named a non-existent generic structured-diagnostic controller test and failed before collection.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Strict path resolution returned FileNotFoundError before pytest, Harness, broker, model or provider activity.

correction.action: Resolve the test inventory with rg --files and rerun using only existing exact paths.
correction.prevention_control: Grouped provider-free path selection is derived from a current rg --files reading.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the inventory-unresolved test path and exact-path correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A no-retry guard must distinguish retry control flow from mandatory zero-valued retry evidence fields.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first focused test prohibited the substring retry while also requiring automatic_retry_count, so its assertions contradicted each other.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Provider-free pytest identified the mandatory field as the rejected substring.

correction.action: Replace the substring ban with structural one-launch, no-unbounded-loop and zero-count assertions.
correction.prevention_control: The focused guard checks behavior structurally while preserving mandatory evidence vocabulary.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the contradictory substring guard and structural replacement.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Incident stage values must come from the register schema's closed vocabulary.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first draft used verification instead of deterministic_verification for two observations.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Schema validation rejected the draft before the pattern report was accepted.

correction.action: Use deterministic_verification and retain schema validation before publication.
correction.prevention_control: Clockwork now exclusively receives incident observations and validates the fixed vocabulary.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the unadmitted stage and fixed-vocabulary correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Related incidents must satisfy attempt-peer identity rather than topical proximity.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The second draft linked incidents with distinct attempt identities only because they were topically related.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The deterministic register validator rejected attempt peer linkage mismatch.

correction.action: Remove topical-only links and retain empty peer lists for independent attempts.
correction.prevention_control: Clockwork allocates peer relationships from explicit incident source identity.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the topical peer links and identity-based correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Checkpoint completed-stage text must remain within the schema's 500-character bound.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first read-only checkpoint check rejected an overlong completed-stage field before transaction preparation.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Clockwork returned checkpoint_tick_completed_stage with no command or publication action.

correction.action: Reduce the same facts to a bounded completed-stage string and rerun the read-only check.
correction.prevention_control: Clockwork validates text bounds before transaction preparation or command execution.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected overlong checkpoint text and bounded replacement.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Incident intake and canonical register, pattern and AGENTS publication must pass only through clockwork.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first implementation commit directly updated the three clockwork-owned incident projections and created canonical drift.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: The occupied-checkpoint dry run returned canonical_drift before command execution or publication.

correction.action: Restore all three canonical surfaces byte-for-byte from the active generation and submit observations only through this version-two intent.
correction.prevention_control: Clockwork validates zero drift and remains the exclusive canonical publisher before every checkpoint and closeout.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the canonical-owner bypass, byte-exact restoration and clockwork-only incident intake.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Every yielded validation process must retain its session identifier until final exit capture.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: One grouped test yielded at 96 percent without exposing its session identifier, so its final exit reading was unavailable after process completion.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: A process-absence reading found no live test process while the captured result had no exit code.

correction.action: Rerun the remaining test file with explicit session and final exit capture.
correction.prevention_control: Long process wrappers always emit and retain session_id before waiting for completion.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the lost yielded-process exit reading and explicit session-retention correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: Adapter probe methods must use the orchestrator preflight's fixed vocabulary before worker dispatch.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first prelaunch receipt used native_harness_prelaunch, which is not an admitted adapter probe method.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Preflight returned adapter_probe_method_invalid and worker_dispatch_permitted false before process creation.

correction.action: Use the admitted synthetic_fixture method in a distinct corrected receipt.
correction.prevention_control: Preflight's fixed adapter method vocabulary remains a dispatch prerequisite.

agent_error_observations.baton_summary: records the rejected adapter method and admitted synthetic-fixture correction.

agent_error_observations.expected_invariant: A standalone synthetic baseline must not be represented as an Ariadne task-handoff worktree.
agent_error_observations.observed_error: The first prelaunch runtime state supplied the disposable synthetic repository as a handoff workspace receipt.
agent_error_observations.detection_method: Preflight rejected workspace_not_clean and workspace_not_at_handoff before worker dispatch.

correction.action: Remove the false handoff receipt and retain the root identity in preparation and checkpoint evidence only.
correction.prevention_control: Ariadne workspace receipts are reserved for task-handoff worktrees; standalone synthetic roots use their own evidence schemas.
